messages:
mike: Heads up — us-east1 scratchpool iops > 200k for 20m, seeing GPU attach failures and queue backlog. infra-bot already fired an alert.
infra-bot: [ALERT] scratchpool_io > 200000 (us-east1) — 20m sustained. see /dash/scratch-iops and /runbooks/scratch-gpu-attach.md
sarah: confirming. several node groups showing high read spikes, scheduler pending pods ~120, backoff ramping.
jerry: that aligns with the scrub rollout we did last night (raised concurrency). suspect janitor scrub rate is saturating NVMe.
lina: scrub concurrency on us-east1 set to 16 currently (policy from rollout). dropping to 6 reduced iops last time. can hotfix the env var.
mike: quick decision: throttle scrub now to restore attach throughput. aware this prolongs scrub backlog but lowers immediate SLO risk.
nguyen: quick mitigation: set --scrub-rate=0.4 and reduce cleaner replicas in us-east1. also disable aggressive trim for 30m.
sarah: patch ready to apply to infra-us-east1. will scope rollout to that region only.
mike: runbook steps? paste commands please.
sarah: run these in order:
```
kubectl set env deployment/janitor JANITOR_SCRUB_RATE=0.4 -n infra-us-east1
kubectl set env deployment/janitor ENABLE_AGGRESSIVE_TRIM=false -n infra-us-east1
kubectl scale deployment/janitor --replicas=2 -n infra-us-east1
```
jerry: doing it now. will monitor iops and attach queue.
[lina reacts with :eyes:]
nguyen: also enabling local cache for common ML images (kv-prefix cache) to cut read amplification — small config flip.
mike: FYI cross-region routing is an option if this doesn't drop fast. we can spill a fraction of new GPU requests to eu-west1 for 1-2h. costly but keeps latency SLOs.
jerry: ok scrub patch applied. initial effect: iops from 210k -> 68k in ~7m. attach queue down from 120 -> 12.
sarah: metrics look good. leaving patch for 30m to ensure stability then roll back trim flag after backlog drops.
lina: I'll propose a glidepath: shift 15% of new GPU allocations to eu-west1 for 2h to flatten risk while backlog drains.
mike: please make a routing rule and include cost estimate.
sarah: created route: `router-cli set-route --policy glide-us-east1-to-eu-west1 --pct 15 --ttl 2h` — infra-bot should record this.
infra-bot: [ACTION] Router rule applied by sarah (glide-us-east1-to-eu-west1, 15%, 2h).
nguyen: note: approximate egress/exec cost +$120/hr for that spill; finance briefed and okay for 2h emergency.
jerry: observed stable attach rates after 20m. GPU launches normalizing.
lina: short-term mitigations: adaptive scrub rate, regional-scoped scrub windows, and cache expansion. filing RFC: /docs/rfcs/adaptive-scrub.md and scheduling follow-up.
mike: long-term: add adaptive backoff to janitor and prefer off-peak scrubs, plus smarter prefetch of common images.
sarah: shall we schedule a retro with scheduler and janitor owners tomorrow?
mike: yes — 10:30am ops sync. thanks all — great quick work. :thumbsup:
nguyen: leaving monitoring alerts on high-sensitivity for 4h. will report if anything slips.
jerry: closing thread unless we see new attach failures.
lina: noted. adding postmortem ticket for the scrub rollout decision path.
